sourceChecks.files: FilePreviewPane and file-preview-session restore explicitly opened tabs, not a complete Camp file collection. The invented aggregate file tab is removed.
sourceChecks.recipient: CampWorkspace.composerRecipientSummary and structured Mention remain production owners. Prototype shows default Lead hint and @, without a separate recipient button.
sourceChecks.skills: SkillSettings consumes delivery groups; MemberManagement has no Skills/MCP assignment surface.
sourceChecks.latest: Production return-to-latest has a 36 px circular face, 44 px hit area, centered over reading content.
sourceChecks.automation: AutomationEditor/AutomationWorkspace persist a single memberId, not a team. The prototype uses a portrait single select and preserves that member through edits, save and refresh.
sourceChecks.projectPagination: CampNavigation and navigation-window-reader use five initial conversations and five more per step. The sample Coaxi project contains eleven unpinned conversations; folder expansion and per-group limits are independent.
sourceChecks.execution: CampWorkspace continuous process timeline, ExecutionAvatarRail avatar/status semantics, ExecutionStatusGlyph and ExecutionToolGroup command icons. Mobile wraps portraits, keeps each Run independent and compresses terminal headers.
sourceChecks.taskCreation: TaskFields showStatus only in edit mode; create contains title, description, acceptanceCriteria and required current-Camp assignee. Prototype defaults a new Task to pending.
sourceChecks.messageRuntime: The member message header includes Runtime display name (Codex CLI) beside the member; production Runtime configuration ownership remains unchanged.
sourceChecks.settingsGlyph: Settings path copied from current NavigationIcon settings branch.
sourceChecks.focus: Owner request and DESIGN use no focus-only outlines, border changes or halos. DOM input, keyboard navigation, dialog focus and selected states remain.

harnessNotes: The first ten-avatar stress fixture was overwritten by the mounted page state during reload. Seeding on new-document initialization corrected the fixture; all checks were rerun at the original thresholds. This is not production Host or multi-device evidence.
